findings.reason: The Definition permits noncompact Σ “whenever this integral converges,” but does not define the integral or convergence criterion; the available compact-support integration supplier does not cover this case. Define the noncompact integral and convergence convention, then align lem-emg-fx-symplectic-current-boundary’s exhaustion and limiting-flux clause with it.

The metric uses −dt² while t is presented as a time coordinate and R is assigned length units; the item does not specify whether t is a length coordinate or time in seconds with a c factor, nor the units of x and y. State a coordinate and unit convention consistent with the Lorentzian-coordinate supplier.
